simple.meaning: בְּרוֹם (bᵉrôwm) is a Hebrew word meaning “damask (stuff of variegated thread).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בְּרוֹם (H1264) before moving outward to related references.
